name: Nikhil Owalekar
player_statement:
A complete player, Nikhil Owalekar has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 51, with an average of 23.50 and a quick strike rate of 110.16. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 12 sixes and 6 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 6.0 overs, taking 4 wickets at an economy rate of 7.50. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
